name: Chiropractic & Physical Therapy
title: Referral Partners for Chiropractors and PTs | Local Impressions
description: For chiropractors and physical therapists in Naperville, Downers Grove and Lombard: we visit the gyms, studios and running stores near you and track every sign-up.
cardBlurb: We visit the gyms, studios and running stores where active people go.
intro: We find businesses near your practice where active people spend their time. Every month we visit them and introduce your practice by name.
partnersIntro: Active people spend their time at these places, and the staff know them well.

partners.name: Gyms and fitness studios
partners.why: Members train often and care about how their body moves.

partners.name: Yoga and pilates studios
partners.why: Regulars pay close attention to posture, balance and how they feel.

partners.name: Running stores
partners.why: Runners come in for new shoes and talk about their training with the staff.

partners.name: Bike shops
partners.why: Riders who spend long hours on the bike stop in for tune-ups and gear.

partners.name: Martial arts and dance studios
partners.why: Students of every age stay active, and their families know the staff.

partners.name: Golf shops and indoor golf
partners.why: Golfers come in all year to practice, play and shop.

treatsIntro: We bring coffee and treats for everyone on shift, from the front desk to the coaches.
treatExamples: Coffee and pastries for a gym's early morning crew
Cold drinks and snacks for a running store's weekend staff
Coffee and cookies for a bike shop's mechanics
portalNote: Each sign-up lands in your portal, and your front desk makes the call, not us.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: When our team visits, you and each partner agree to promote each other. Nobody is paid per referral or per patient.

notes.title: No patient records, ever
notes.text: We never receive patient records, and partners never see who signed up. The sign-up form asks no health questions.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We make no medical or health claims. We describe your services only in words you approve.

exclusivity: When our team visits, partners agree to promote one practice like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Do I need to come along on the visits?
faq.a: No. Our field team makes every visit, and you see each stop in your portal.

faq.q: What about the rules for healthcare practices?
faq.a: Partner programs for healthcare practices are reviewed for compliance with applicable state rules before launch. If your lawyer wants to read the partner agreement, we'll send it.

faq.q: Can we keep the relationships we already have?
faq.a: Yes. We skip businesses you already work with unless you ask, and those relationships stay yours.

aboutText: I'm asking about referral partners for my chiropractic or physical therapy practice.
